events.text: Wollongong was laid down by Cockatoo Docks & Engineering Company.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Wollongong was laid down by Cockatoo Docks & Engineering Company on 29 January 1941 .

events.text: Wollongong was launched by the wife of Jack Beasley.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was launched on 5 July 1941 , by the wife of Jack Beasley

events.text: Wollongong was commissioned into the RAN.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was commissioned into the RAN on 23 October 1941 .

events.subject: self
events.quote: On 11 January 1942 , she was sent to Singapore

events.text: Singapore was surrendered to the Japanese.
events.subject: other
events.quote: before it was surrendered to the Japanese on 15 February

events.text: SS British Judge was torpedoed on the night of 28 February.
events.subject: other
events.quote: the damaged SS British Judge , which was torpedoed on the night of 28 February

events.text: The main convoy and the escorting sloop was sunk by a Japanese cruiser group.
events.subject: other
events.quote: The main convoy and the escorting sloop was sunk on 4 March by a Japanese cruiser group

events.text: Wollongong sailed to Diego Garcia to join the British Eastern Fleet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: before sailing on 14 September to Diego Garcia to join the British Eastern Fleet

events.text: Wollongong was called on to shell the beached German submarine U-617.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 1943 , while in the Mediterranean , Wollongong was called on to shell the beached German submarine U-617

events.subject: self
events.quote: Wollongong returned to Australian waters in February 1945

events.subject: self
events.quote: before returning to Australia at the end of 1945

events.subject: self
events.quote: She was decommissioned in Sydney on 11 February 1946

events.text: Wollongong was recommissioned into the RNLN and renamed HNLMS Banda.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was recommissioned into the RNLN , and renamed HNLMS Banda

events.text: The corvette remained with the RNLN until April 1950.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The corvette remained with the RNLN until April 1950

events.text: The ship was transferred to the new Indonesian Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The ship was transferred to the new Indonesian Navy in April 1950

events.text: The ship was renamed KRI Radjawali.
